verdict.rationale: Glama ships its own documented, machine-discoverable OpenAPI 3.0.3 API with /v1 paths for servers, connectors, instances and usage, plus a hosted reference with a Try-it panel. That API covers the directory, not the whole UI. The Gateway has no separate REST spec, and nothing shows that UI features such as chat, hosting build configuration, per-tool access control or the claim panel can be driven through the API. missing for 10: documented API coverage of chat, hosting/deployment configuration, per-tool access control, Gateway management and claiming; any statement or evidence of UI–API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Glama publishes an OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for its MCP directory API
The spec covers the directory API; the Gateway is an MCP-protocol proxy without a separate REST spec
The vendor-hosted API reference carries a per-endpoint "Try it" panel
